title: China Arms Iran Against U.S, Flies Military Equipment To Tehran Despite NOTAM? Shock Details Out
text: China Arms Iran Against U.S, Flies Military Equipment To Tehran Despite NOTAM? Shock Details OutIran’s airspace was largely empty overnight, with only two civilian flights visible over the country as regional tensions kept most commercial traffic grounded, according to flight-tracking data. The only aircraft observed were operated by Mahan Air, an Iranian carrier designated by the United States for allegedly transporting arms, equipment and funds on behalf of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. The two Mahan Air flights were tracked departing from southern China, one from Guangzhou and the other from Shenzhen, before heading west toward Tehran. No other commercial flights were seen crossing Iranian airspace during the same period, an unusual development for a region that typically serves as a major transit corridor between Asia, Europe and the Middle East.
